column1: # kind: rules  The coarse change → usage map of scripts/regress.py impact (dm/tools/usage.py): which rows of a game's usage manifest (dm/games/<id>/usage.tsv) a change can reach.
# Columns: file glob[:function regex] <TAB> usage pattern <TAB> why
#   A rule with a function regex applies to the changed functions it matches (the function around each changed hunk); the file's rules without one apply to the other changed
#   lines of that file. A rule whose why starts with "fallback" applies only when no other rule of the range matched (a translator binary that changed with its sources).
#   Usage pattern: <kind>:<name glob> (kind * = any; *:* = every game with a manifest), "-" = no game (tests, docs), "profile" = the game whose profile folder it is.
#   Host code is also followed through its callers to the NVN entry points and HLE functions that reach it (usage.py host_graph); these rules add what a call graph cannot see
#   A pattern that every game of an API matches (*:*, api:*, shader:stage:*, svc:*, hle:*, present:*) is broad: the report lists the games it reaches apart from those a
#   (the replay runs on its own threads, the prepare step at the first submission, the chain offline). test_usage.py checks that every glob matches a file of the repository.
